scope: Owned synthetic libraries and native APFS images; headless application-model/delegate checks and sample layout renders. Not real Mac authentication, native clicks, sustained capture/power or a competitor performance benchmark.

thread_sanitizer.scope: Vault, library location/workspace, backup/restore and workspace lifecycle

checks: create initializes and detaches, public handle closed
managed handle writes and retrieves on verified volume
supplied actual older writer refuses schema18 without changing DB bytes
import and standalone Whisper workspaces remain in managed volume and clean on exit
explicit plaintext backup/Markdown export, private source staging cleaned
held reader keeps mounted closing state; no forced detach or plaintext reopening
verified native migration remounts with history and retains original
missing source refuses before destination creation
renamed attached package remains visibly attached despite stale OS image path
relocatable public handle still reaches schema18 and fences supplied older writer after rename
moved package closes public handle and normally unmounts/ejects verified backing device
unmounted filesystem remains pending until remaining encrypted image detaches; original history survived remount

interruptions.scope: Actual SIGINT during observed owned hdiutil create/attach helpers; random in-memory passphrase, no Keychain or normal library

known_speech_failure_recovery.scope: Previously observed failures only. Original frozen corpus reports are unchanged; this is not a new ASR quality or held-out result.

package.scope: Separately staged adhoc signed arm64 package; not installed or native authentication acceptance

layout.scope: owned synthetic NSHostingView renders and normal quit path; not native clicks or authentication

retained_regressions.trigger: NSApplication terminateLater entered a nested modal loop from a MainActor caller
retained_regressions.before: Owned layout preview timed out after exporting its image
retained_regressions.fix: Return to normal run loop, finish verified lock, then request exit again; duplicate quit requests share cleanup
retained_regressions.after: Owned delegate regression and all six preview process exits pass

retained_regressions.fix: Bind saved device/UUID/root/image identities, current kernel mount and backing image device; use relocatable relative handle, retained close descriptor and verified non-force unmount/eject recovery
retained_regressions.after: Native core, app session and signed CLI relocation/read/old-writer/lock/remount checks pass

retained_regressions.trigger: Qualification-only known-failure harness referenced archived worktree
retained_regressions.before: First qualification attempt passed native vault and interruption groups, then stopped before recovery cases
retained_regressions.fix: Corrected private harness copy points at active checkout; signed executable and product source unchanged
retained_regressions.after: Remaining 13 groups pass; original attempt and corrected continuation retained

credential_status.implementation: Data Protection Keychain userPresence + WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly; fresh explicit-auth context
credential_status.current_adhoc_build: Controls disabled by app-identifier entitlement preflight; passphrase unlock works

limits: Original libraries, exports, backups and APFS snapshots remain independent copies; no secure-erasure claim
Opening an older source library upgrades it to schema18; retained originals preserve history but are not byte-identical/schema-downgrade backups. Older builds refuse schema18.
Mounted data and process/model memory remain accessible under the Mac user; not an execution enclave or forensic RAM-erasure guarantee
Busy independent readers keep locking pending; no forced detach
Source revision/settings checks span the copy, not a permanent write lock against future independent changes
Real signed-distribution authentication, keyboard/VoiceOver/device/sleep-wake, disk-full/large-library migration and older-macOS acceptance remain open
Physical capture power, 24h completion, multimodal search and broad competitor/top-three gates remain open
